unavailable.r9_contract: History service/page unavailable: missing portion labelled, not zero.
unavailable.note: ReadFailure displays service/read failure separately from empty and zero.

forbidden.r9_contract: No restricted audit metadata or inaccessible target title in denial.
forbidden.note: Server read-denial/role visibility branches exist but shared scoped purge is absent; mutation 403 currently clears local stored draft (F01).

stale.r9_contract: Show source as-of; refresh appends new accepted history without rewriting old.
stale.note: Generic IntentForm stale Reload exists; scope draft retention/rebase/changed preview acknowledgement needs targeted checks.

conflict.r9_contract: Precondition failure, distinguished: absent precondition is 428 and has nothing to reconcile; stale precondition is 412 and routes to refresh-and-rebase. The draft is preserved in both. Blind overwrite is not offered.
conflict.note: 412 maps to stale, but 428/non-CAS precondition errors fall to generic error in action-result.ts:129–132. Per-operation differences need explicit binding.

partial.r9_contract: Paged timeline incomplete until authorized relation traversal completes; counts unavailable if not supplied.
partial.note: No complete screen-specific partial-success/partial-availability binding established.

recovery.r9_contract: Return origin and exact event anchor; preserve filter/time window; no normal-user delete.
recovery.note: IntentForm has same-key frozen payload/re-read controls; refresh alone resets local failure before an authorised read is confirmed (120–126); access-loss and key-conflict paths need review.
